crossRefs.note: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day…

people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
translations.bsb: So they gathered together in Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa’s reign.
translations.kjv: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
translations.asv: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
